newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnights down on high liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnights down on high liquidity.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates remained low on Tuesday amid excess liquidity and the banks actively participated in a central bank auction of short-term federal bonds (STBF), dealers said.

"The rates remained pegged between 1.0 and 2.0 percent," one dealer said. "The banks particpated in the STFB auction by around 12.57 billion rupees at a yield ranging between 15.95 and 17.60 percent." The auction result will be announced later.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan will conduct its regular open market operation on Wednesday and overnights will depend on its result, dealers said. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
